details:
there is already the demonstrated ability in VRC+, 

I'm not asking for the full color customization to be made a free feature.

what I'm asking for is a few custom presets to be made available for all users.

this is an important feature for people with vision/processing problems.

most important is a high contrast theme, aiming to make the info and available actions in the menu as visible as possible (often black background with white text/boarders).

this helps with a lot of conditions. including:

- color blindness (of all 3 types)

- generally blurry vision is easier to see on high contrast.

- astigmatisms

in addition reduced color (as some other in the discord have suggested to me) can help with visual processing disorders, helping people who have difficulty picking out and finding the correct items.

last, dark mode, although it might not strictly be an accessibility feature, a dark mode theme for the UI would be very nice for eye strain, having that available for free would be nice, and i don't think it will cut into the sales of VRC+.
title: Accessibility Ui Color Sets (high contrast, darkmode, reduced colors)
